title.en: Jensen and Satya put 128GB of AI on your desk. Who still needs the cloud?
title.zh: 黄仁勋与纳德拉把128GB AI搬上桌：云账单能少多少？

summary.en: Microsoft and NVIDIA announced RTX Spark PC preorders on October 7. Local and cloud routing remain hybrid; cost savings, privacy and benchmark gains depend on workloads and permissions.
summary.zh: 微软与英伟达10月7日宣布RTX Spark电脑预售。本地与云端仍协同；节省多少成本、隐私是否改善，都取决于任务与权限。

title.en: Kagan and Soai won a Nobel for molecules with two hands. Why does the wrong hand matter?
title.zh: 卡根与索艾靠分子“左右手”拿诺奖：镜像相同，药效也相同吗？

summary.en: The October 7 chemistry Nobel honours non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric synthesis. Controlling molecular handedness matters to chemical manufacturing; this is not a new drug approval or proof of every origin-of-life claim.
summary.zh: 10月7日化学诺奖表彰不对称合成的非线性效应与自催化。分子手性关系化学制造；这不是新药批准，也未破解生命起源所有谜题。
